canonical_api.part_glb_response: Backend checks current source/CAD/manifest and startup-captured mesh SHA before returning bytes

identity.cad_revision_sha256: SHA-256 of concatenated sorted src/cad/*.py bytes
identity.part_shape_sha256: Per-part geometry+CAD+generator revision digest; not a file byte hash
identity.current_input_sha256: Mode/shared YAML, motor curve/sidecar and backend source pins

export_frames.part_step: Local source CAD millimetres; placement not applied
export_frames.assembly_step: Placed assembled CAD millimetres; +Z station aft from nose
export_frames.part_stl: Local or print-oriented/bed-packed CAD millimetres as row print_layout declares

contracts.cad_manifest_gap: Manifest owns semantic source/shape identity and registered filenames, but lacks original per-asset byte SHA and assembly checksum records; this audit pins current bytes separately.

bounded_extension.decision: Viable without CAD generation or backend restart, using a new fixed local/static registry/preparer and current exact document admission
bounded_extension.first_increment: Selected/whole archived GLB and part/assembly STEP with explicit distinct frames; retain STL separately labelled print/local representation or defer
bounded_extension.file_allowlist: Only audited per-part IDs and extension paths plus assembly.glb/assembly.step and provenance JSON; no arbitrary folder/URL or cross-config borrowing
bounded_extension.preparation: Verify recorded audit hashes, resolved identity, all source/CAD pins, manifest hash and selected file bytes before copying to a fixed ignored static folder. No CAD rerun. No copy performed by this audit.
bounded_extension.frontend: Require current document configuration/resolved-spec/CAD/part-shape tuple, complete stable-ID inventory, current selected object and role, then verify expected response byte SHA before saving. Do not accept bare live mesh URL as registration.
bounded_extension.existing_api_option: Selected part GLB can use existing mesh-index+part endpoint if index/current document match the frozen audited tuple and downloaded bytes match the audit hash; assemblies/STEP/STL require static preparation or a later backend change.
bounded_extension.physical_status: Archived/conditional/trainer/concept snapshots only; source role manufactured means model intent, not manufactured/accepted hardware.

gaps: No assembly STL exists for these exports
No present canonical API STEP/STL/assembly download route
No original per-asset byte checksums in legacy CAD manifests; this audit supplies newly pinned local bytes
Part STEP local frame and STL print/local frame must not be presented as RP1 world-placed STEP
No new STEP readback/geometry/manufacturing/physical acceptance from this source/file audit
